recommendation: Keep this commit as-is. It fixes the only in-build stale references found in the seed resource family and aligns the operation examples with the current resource definitions; no further core source change is recommended for FHIR-14254.
issue_request: FHIR-14254 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested consistent names for elements that refer to sequence elements across Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit, using the referenced element name plus Sequence.
initial_application: The issue was initially applied by Jira-tagged commits 5747911b8432630cf2723cebc98907a7118bff53, e7de0775bc639ffc5422d59636df328ea4fc3167, and 38d54b901fc5ed78cc46dbc139000fbe5315501b, which renamed the active resource definitions and many examples but did not update the Claim $submit snippets.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Claim, ClaimResponse, and ExplanationOfBenefit as active resources, and the Claim $submit OperationDefinition references $submit-request.txt and $submit-response.txt as build examples. Current Claim and ClaimResponse StructureDefinition source defines Claim.item.careTeamSequence and ClaimResponse.item.itemSequence. Other legacy-name hits were fhir.ini rename mappings, retired ProcessRequest source, or the separate legacy QUICK model definition rather than current Claim/ClaimResponse/EOB source.
reconciliation: Changed source/claim/$submit-request.txt from careTeamLinkId to careTeamSequence and source/claim/$submit-response.txt from sequenceLinkId to itemSequence.
source_changes: source/claim/$submit-request.txt: replaced careTeamLinkId with careTeamSequence in the Claim request example item.
source/claim/$submit-response.txt: replaced sequenceLinkId with itemSequence in the ClaimResponse response example item.
